intent.statement: Deliver the discriminating GAP contrast. Information clock: residual uncertainty spikes at PRE1 (0.0473***) and falls to insignificance the instant the deal is public (GAP 0.0018 n.s.), a significant PRE1-GAP drop of 0.0455** and a large peak-to-completion swing (PRE1-POST 0.0723***). Transaction clock: the cash ratio is elevated at PRE1 (0.0061**), does NOT fall at announcement (PRE1-GAP drop 0.0006 n.s.), and declines only once cash leaves at completion (GAP-POST 0.0210***, POST -0.0155***). Because the GAP CashRatio level (0.0055) is positive but insignificant, cash persistence rests on the absence of a PRE1-GAP decline, not on a significant gap level.
intent.reason: These two legs jointly ARE the H1b/C1 contrast: uncertainty resolves at announcement (theta_gap=0, the MNPI fingerprint) while cash persists through the gap (kappa_gap>0). Leading with the GAP contrast follows the 2.4 P2.2 Wald discriminator; the kappa_gap honesty note keeps the register exact since the GAP CashRatio level is n.s.
evidence: section34_phaseA_redteam.json 3.3 (kappa_gap honesty note: GAP CashRatio 0.0055 n.s.; persistence rests on null PRE1-GAP drop)

serves: delivers the C1/H1b core; pays off H1b (theta_-1>0, theta_gap=0, kappa_gap>0 read off the null PRE1-GAP decline)
